dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: #Hey, it's you, {NICKNAME}! How are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: If you want to pass the time, you can't go wrong hanging out with me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Pretty good! I'm surprised how awesome your place is!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: This is an adeptus relic from Liyue, right? It's incredible. I thought you were joking when you asked me to get into this pot.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I had no idea what to say, I didn't know if I should object or just follow along...

choices.text: What was your objection going to be?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Something like, "Are you blind? I can't squeeze into that!"

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Haha, Paimon told me that she had the same reaction when she first saw the pot.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: If she couldn't get in, there would be no chance for me.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Who would have thought that a little push from you, and poof — we're in here!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: A wide open view, fresh air... It's such a nice place!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm glad you like it.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Of course I like it. I could easily live here forever.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: *sigh* Maybe I can open a second "Naganohara" here?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: You can invite all of your friends to see the fireworks. Consider it a gift from me to you!

choices.text: What would you have said to humor me?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Like, "Let me send over 'Tarou the Goldfish,' the most trusty fish in my aquarium, to accompany you!"

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I'm sure it'll be able to get in. It's a goldfish after all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you want to chat?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Sure, you know I love to talk. Let me think, is there anything interesting going on these days...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Ah, right. You've got such a large piece of paradise here. Do you have any plans for it, you know, besides just living here?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Ever thought about building a parlor or a show room? Or maybe a training ground?

choices.text: I'd love to do some business like you.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Wha—? There might have been a slight misunderstanding, you see, my family's business is not the usual kind of business.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I know merchants in Liyue are really good at making Mora, they're experts at landing deals both big and small.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: However, our family's customers are mostly regulars, so we put most of our focus on those relationships.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: My pops and I, we mainly do business so that we won't let everyone down.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Anyway, when it's finished, let me know. I'll set off some fireworks to celebrate.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What would you build if you were me?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Me?... Hehe, I'd build a playground!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: With toys everywhere! They'd be flashing, moving, and spinning. Also, tasty snacks for whenever I'm hungry!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Living in a world like that would be a dream come true!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll think about it.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: No, no. No need to seriously consider it. It's just a little fantasy of mine.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: But... I'm happy to hear you say that.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: A playground... Ahh, how wonderful.

choices.text: I want to build a garden.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Wow, good idea! That sounds really interesting. I want to help.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: If you need anything, just tell me. If it can be found in Inazuma, I can get it for you.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Thanks to the family business, I've got tons of connections. Haha!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Well, I guess I can't get you the stars, or the moon. But pretty much anything else.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you want to do?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I want to know more about youuuu!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I've heard people everywhere tell tales of your heroics, and I've seen it first-hand adventuring with you.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: But the more I learn, the more curious I become — what makes you so special?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: There is always a reason for everything. For example, I like to talk because when I was a kid, Pops really seemed to enjoy listening to me.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I like fireworks because creating incredible fireworks makes me feel so proud of my work.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: So what's there for you?

choices.text: There is someone I want to see.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: So that's what drives you.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: And you don't want your reunion to be a disappointing one, do you?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Wow, I'm really impressed. Honestly, I envy you!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I'll help you. No matter where it is, you must be reunited!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hehe, sorry, I'm getting too excited.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: But I've decided, I want to retrace your path!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Starting from Mondstadt, to Liyue, and then to Inazuma... I will go see the sights you've seen and meet the people you've come across.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: That's what one has to do if they want to get to know someone completely!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Isn't that a bit much?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Sorry, I don't mean to put any pressure on you. I was just, well... how should I put it? Simply, I...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I want to know more about youuuu!

choices.text: There are people I want to help.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: So that's what motivates you.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: You don't want to see anyone suffer.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: You are like a storybook hero, so awesome.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hmm, that means I'm friends with a hero, doesn't it?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I'll support you with all I've got, so go ahead and write the rest of your story!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Yoimiya.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: #Morning, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: What a nice day! Let's go have some fun!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Yoimiya.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: #Hehe, night. Sweet dreams, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I hope you dream about my fireworks.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Do you want to chat?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Anything you want to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Wow, is that an open-air hot spring I see? Amazing~!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: There's no better feeling than jumping into a hot spring when you're done with work for the day!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Do you wanna join me? Relaxing in a hot spring, chatting away, ahh, it's one of the greatest feelings!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Yes! This is the kind of atmosphere I live for, I absolutely love it!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I'm super impressed, it's pretty amazing that you managed to do this place up like a shopping street. Is there a Naganohara Fireworks here, too? I wanna go find it!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Come on, come with me! After all the effort you've put into this place, we should have some fun here!
